_about: Political figures whose convictions are seeded the first time Living World meets them. Matched in game by plugin + base form ID (from Mantella's data/Skyrim/skyrim_characters.csv, checked 2026-11-24). Values are -1..1 per dimension: empire, stormcloaks, thalmor = how they regard that power; negotiation = willingness to negotiate with the other side of the civil war; concordat = support for the White-Gold Concordat; ceasefire = support for a temporary ceasefire between the Empire and the Stormcloaks; alliance = support for an Empire-Stormcloak alliance against the Thalmor. 'personal' is what they believe; 'official' is the line their faction holds, as they understand it (left out where it is the same). confidence 0..1 says how sure the lore is; low-confidence values are said gently in the prompt. Every dimension is written on its own: nobody's Concordat view is inferred from their Thalmor view. These are starting convictions only, never outcomes: nothing here makes anyone agree to anything. 'circle' is the court whose members hear each other's public statements (an existing-gossip community). 'cares' is what they argue from.

figures.name: Ulfric Stormcloak
figures.role: Jarl of Windhelm and leader of the Stormcloak rebellion
figures.cares: Talos worship, Skyrim ruled by Nords, his own legitimacy as a claimant to the High King's throne, and never looking weak

figures.name: Galmar Stone-Fist
figures.role: Ulfric's housecarl and general of the Stormcloak army
figures.cares: winning the war, Ulfric's honour, and his soldiers' lives not being thrown away

figures.name: Jorleif
figures.cares: Windhelm's treasury and supply, and keeping Ulfric's court running

figures.name: Brunwulf Free-Winter
figures.role: a veteran of the Great War living in Windhelm, critical of Ulfric's treatment of the Dunmer
figures.cares: fair treatment of Windhelm's Dark Elves and Argonians, and the lives of ordinary Nords

figures.name: General Tullius
figures.role: Military Governor of Skyrim and commander of the Imperial Legion there
figures.cares: ending the rebellion, the Legion's readiness for the next war with the Dominion, and the Empire's authority

figures.name: Legate Rikke
figures.role: Legate of the Imperial Legion, a Nord who fought beside Ulfric and Galmar in the Great War
figures.cares: the Legion, Skyrim's Nords on both sides, and old comrades now her enemies

figures.name: Elisif the Fair
figures.role: Jarl of Solitude and widow of High King Torygg, whom Ulfric killed
figures.cares: justice for Torygg, Solitude's people, and being taken seriously as a ruler

figures.name: Falk Firebeard
figures.role: steward of Solitude and Elisif's counsellor
figures.cares: Elisif's standing, Solitude's stability, and not provoking the Thalmor

figures.name: Balgruuf the Greater
figures.role: Jarl of Whiterun, who has kept his hold out of the war
figures.cares: Whiterun's interests first, staying out of the civil war, the dragon threat, and his own authority

figures.name: Proventus Avenicci
figures.cares: the treasury, trade on the roads, and caution

figures.name: Irileth
figures.cares: the Jarl's safety and Whiterun's defences

figures.name: Hrongar
figures.role: the Jarl's brother, who wants Whiterun to join the Legion
figures.cares: the Empire's cause and his brother's honour

figures.name: Elenwen
figures.role: First Emissary of the Aldmeri Dominion in Skyrim
figures.cares: the Dominion's interests, enforcing the Concordat, and Talos worship stamped out

figures.name: Ondolemar
figures.role: head of the Thalmor Justiciars in Markarth
figures.cares: enforcing the Concordat and finding Talos worshippers
